page.title: Οι απόψεις των Ελλήνων εκπαιδευτικών ειδικής αγωγής  σχετικά με τη διδασκαλία σε μαθητές με μεταναστευτικό/προσφυγικό υπόβαθρο και ειδικές εκπαιδευτικές ανάγκες
page.attribution: hellanicus; Οι απόψεις των Ελλήνων εκπαιδευτικών ειδικής αγωγής  σχετικά με τη διδασκαλία σε μαθητές με μεταναστευτικό/προσφυγικό υπόβαθρο και ειδικές εκπαιδευτικές ανάγκες

docai_lines.text: ABSTRACT
Background: The growing number of individuals with mental disorders and the negative
effect of economic crisis on psychiatric services in Greece result to a complicated issue
that needs to be solved as soon as possible. E-mental health services may become a part
of the solution.
Objective: E-mental health services are growing fast as technology and its knowledge are
reachable and affordable to everyone. The combination of these services under the
community psychiatry principals for the psychiatric reformation, can lead to the
establishment of Online Community Psychiatry and the foundation of a National e-Mental
Health Community Center.
Methods: The keywords “e-mental health" was searched on World Wide Web and PubMed
database. A general internet search was also conducted about latest statistics on internet
usage.
Results: The search yielded 112 studies, they were reviewed and 9 of them were found
absolute relevant to the subject. Alongside a critical review of Online Mental Health
Services on the world wide web, greek and international bibliography, resulted to the
approach and construction of an atheoretical model for the future creation of a National E-
Mental Health Center.
Conclusions: The promising results of e-mental health services all over the world and the
need for new modern and available for all psychiatric services, lead to the conclusion that
a National e-Mental Health Community Center has a lot to offer to the community and the
science of Psychiatry.
SUBJECT AREA: Psychiatry and internet
Keywords: Internet, Mental Health, Community Psychiatry, Community Mental Health
Center, Tele-psychiatry
